title: PHP: two critical flaws (php2shell)
summary: PHP announced fixes for two critical remote code execution flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2) for 21 October at 14:00 UTC, after details leaked. Affected and fixed versions come with the release.

binaries.pendingNote: PHP publishes the fixed versions on 21 Oct at 14:00 UTC. Update as soon as your branch has one; end-of-life branches may get none, so plan to move off them.
binaries.fix: Update PHP to the fixed release for your branch.
